description: OpenCode plugin: DataLens Platform harness. Registers the get_iam_token and get_harness_session_id tools natively, bootstraps the main_orchestration and sparkconnect skills and the engineer/scheduler subagents into ~/.config/opencode, writes mcp/permissio

detail.description_zh: OpenCode 插件：DataLens 平台工具。原生注册 get_iam_token 和 get_harness_session_id 工具，将 main_orchestration 和 sparkconnect 技能以及 engineer/scheduler 子代理引导到 ~/.config/opencode，写入 mcp/permissio
